name: &8Your profile
description: The viewer's balances, title progress, premium tier and every title bracket. Content port CP3.

description: Every item blueprint as granted, searchable, filterable by category and paged (items.catalog). Content port CP4.

variableBindings.expression: &7A list of all items in the game

name: &8Premium tiers
description: Every premium tier (premium permission groups by weight) and the viewer's own. Content port CP5.

name: &8Player manager
description: Online players the viewer outranks (users.online; with knk.admin.user.manage.all every player, online and offline, self included) -> the editor. Content port CP8.

name: &8Edit player
description: Steppers for coins/gems/XP, title, groups, mode, salary, freeze, kick, ban for the player in ctx.userId/ctx.name. Content port CP8.

variableBindings.expression: &7Pays the salary owed since the last payout
&7Frozen players can't move, chat or use commands

name: &8Set title
description: Pick a title bracket for the player in ctx.userId (users.titles); sets their XP to its minimum. Content port CP8.

actions.paramsJson: {"actionTypeId":"users.set-title","actionParamsJson":"{\"userId\":\"$ctx.userId$\",\"bracketId\":\"$row.getBracketId$\"}","prompt":"Set $ctx.name$'s title to $row.getName$ (XP becomes $row.getMinExperience$)? Click Confirm or Cancel."}

name: &8Groups
description: Every permission group; click to add the player in ctx.userId or (confirmed) remove them (users.groups). Ranks (Default + premium tiers) are one per player: a rank click is a confirmed switch and removing a premium rank drops back to Default (plugin-side). Content port CP8.

name: &8Discoveries
description: Every discoverable town, district, structure and gate with the viewer's progress (discoveries.rows). Domain discovery KNG-20.

variableBindings.expression: &7(after the last one: every type again)
